_comment: Channels need Slack channel IDs (C...). People can be e-mail addresses or Slack user IDs (U...). hr_group is a user-group ID (S...). See README.
_period_comment: The cycle for month M pays support dates from start_day of M-1 to end_day of M (21 Sep -> 20 Oct for October). Dates outside it are flagged for the reviewer.
